title: Overload by number, type and order

blocks.text: Overloaded methods share a name and differ in their parameter lists: in how many parameters there are, in their types, or in their order. The compiler picks the one that fits the call.

cases.says: add(5.5, 10.25) is 15.75: the double overload keeps the fractions.

concepts: Methods are overloaded by the number, the types or the order of their parameters.
